delete.description:
Hard-delete a user who has no data (no lectures, uploads, feedback or notes edits);
anyone else is deactivated instead (``409 user_has_data``).

post.description:
Suggest the lecture form's fields from the first minutes of a completed upload.

Synchronous (about 15-40 s). One suggestion runs per upload at a time (claimed under the
upload's row lock, then made without holding it). Provider failures are a 200 with every
value null and ``reason_if_unavailable``.

get.description:
How long a recording of ``duration_ms`` will take to process, from this centre's
recent finished lectures that used the currently configured ASR. Any signed-in role:
it holds only stage timings, no lecture content.

The published ``LectureAnalysis``; ``lecture_notes`` is the teacher's version when one
was saved (see ``GET /lectures/{id}/notes``), else the pipeline draft.

post.description:
Mark the lecture's current results as seen by the caller (e.g. "mark as read" in a
list) without opening the analysis.

get.description: A short-lived presigned GET for the original recording, for playback and seeking.

patch.description:
Change the lecture's metadata and reprocess what depends on it. The teacher's edited
notes are kept (flagged stale if the transcript's segments change).

post.description:
Approve the current notes (the teacher's version, or the pipeline draft as is). Notes
whose citations no longer match the transcript must be edited first.

schema.title: Response List Feedback Findings  Finding Id  Feedback Get

get.description:
Per week or month (by lecture ``created_at``, UTC): each deterministic metric's
distribution over that bucket's done lectures. Empty buckets are present with n=0.

How teachers judged the findings, per category and severity: whether the released
categories are trustworthy. Counts only: no comments, names or per-teacher split.

MetadataPatch.title: MetadataPatch
MetadataPatch.description:
Fields of ``LectureMetadataInput`` to change (omitted = unchanged); the merged result is
validated like creation.

MetadataSuggestionOut.title: MetadataSuggestionOut
MetadataSuggestionOut.description:
Prefill for the lecture form. Every field is a suggestion for the teacher to confirm;
``reason_if_unavailable`` set means there is none (all values null).

MetricBrief.title: MetricBrief
MetricBrief.description:
One scalar metric of the published report. ``value`` null means missing data and
``reason`` says why; otherwise ``reason`` explains a low ``confidence`` (else null).

NotesIn.title: NotesIn
NotesIn.description: Full replacement of the notes' sections (markdown is always rendered by code).

message.title: Message
message.default: If this email belongs to an active account, a sign-in code has been sent.

SuggestedField.title: SuggestedField
SuggestedField.description:
``value`` is what the form field would be prefilled with (null: no suggestion);
``reason`` cites what was said or which hint was used.

TranscriptOut.title: TranscriptOut
TranscriptOut.description:
``transcript`` is a ``Transcript`` for both ``raw=false`` (the analysis' redacted
transcript) and ``raw=true`` (the transcript stage's unredacted one).
